programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Along with classic characters ('The Old Folks' and Alice Portnoy), TV commercial spoofs and the firing of Donald Duck (Byner) are on tap tonight.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Andy Griffith guests, retelling a familiar Aesop fable in his own inimitable fashion
Find out why is Kevin Pollack dressed as Cupid when he joins the show?
TV’s polymath Carl Reiner chats about his wife Estelle, a recent nose injury, his frequent forgetfulness, and the smash hit flick When Harry Met Sally written and directed by his son, Rob Reiner.
No one rocks a polyester leisure suit like sex god Burt Reynolds. Comic Buddy Hackett’s orgasm-sneeze makes for really compelling TV. Master complainer Don Rickles rounds out the show.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Ken Berry and Natalie Cole are tonight's guests!

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Life is a cabaret when Joel Grey and Vincent Price are guest starring!

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tonight's episode features guest stars Ruth Buzzi and Richard Crenna, who take part in a salute to the 'bad girls' of cinema in a series of satiric spoofs of classic movies and their tropes.
Special guests Mickey Rooney and John Davidson join Carol and Vicki to tell the tale of "The Four Funns Of Broadway," a show-biz chronicle of a vaudeville family packed with songs and laughs.
George Burns takes on Groucho Marx and young people and Rodney Dangerfield continues to get no respect. Plus, Johnny talks with Michael Constantine and Shana Alexander.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Tony Bennett, Totie Fields, The Mecners, Nancy Sinatra, Hendra and Ullett, and Count Basie
This "Family Show" features Dick as an airport traveler getting a long, awkward farewell from his family, and Tim as a steelworker seeking to do in his wife (Carol).

programmes.t: Comedy Legends from The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Joan Rivers' "Small-Town Life and Flying"; David Frye's "Celebrity Impressions"; Alan King's "Golf Stories and Wife"; Charlie Manna's "Crazy NYC, What Makes a Loser, Reads Diary of His NYC Days"
Dallas star Patrick Duffy commemorates Johnny’s recent wedding, to wife #3, with a hilarious gift: A set of towels With Velcro monograms for quick switches.
In tonight's episode, Carol contends with a peeping tom. Later, Carol, Dick, Vicki, and Tim offer up a concert that will have your toes tapping.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Guest Shirley MacLaine joins Carol in sharing some of their fan mail
Oscar winner Bruce Dern talks about getting his big break and his neighbor Robert Redford. Psychiatrist Sam Dunkell analyzes dreams and sleeps positions.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: The great Jonathan Winters returns as Carol's guest, highlighted by a dual role in 'The Wonderful World Of Hospitals.'
Mr. Warmth himself, Don Rickles, guests as a cantankerous house painter on the latest "Carol & Sis" sketch. And George and Zelda (Harvey and Carol) face a home invasion by a robber (played by Lyle.)

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Everly Brothers, Steppenwolf, Erich Brenn, Phil Crosby, Sergio Franchi, and Henny Youngman
The Velvet Fog rolls in once again as Mel Torme returns in a guest appearance! Mel discovers the greatest superstar behind the counter of a drugstore in Vanessa Vanilla (played, of course, by Carol.)
Mickey Rooney compares notes with Johnny on their many marriages. Comic Paul Rodriguez riffs on Mexicans picking fruit and the fun of annoying white drivers on LA freeways.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests John Wayne, Rowan & Martin, and Gail Martin.
Bernadette Peters and Cass Elliot guest star in the latest "As The Stomach Turns", and Lyle causes havoc and absurdity on a live television production as a drunken sound effects operator.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tim Conway hops a plane with the cast for a performance in Sydney, Australia!
Nanette Fabray and the lovely Michele Lee guest star in another hilarious episode that includes a commercial take-off and the continuing story of the soap opera spoof "As The Stomach Turns."
Eight-time Emmy winner, Betty White wanted to be a forest ranger, but that gig was off-limits to women in the early 1940s. She turned to writing and was the first woman to produce a sitcom.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Rolling Stones, Louis Armstrong, Joan Rivers, Jim Nabors, Holiday on Ice, and Robert Goulet.
Guest star William Conrad appears in the latest "The Family" sketch, as a gentleman caller for Mama (Vicki). Also: Harvey's uncomfortable news for his wife (Carol) gives her a bad case of twitches.
Guest Ken Berry joins Carol in a salute to Warner Brothers, with a pair of spoofs of "Mrs. Skeffington" and "Yankee Doodle Dandy."
Comedienne Joan Rivers kills the crowd with her comedy set, while The Old Folks and the 10th Avenue Family appear in sketches that keep the audience rolling in the aisles.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Joey Bishop, Leonard Barr, and Flip Wilson.
Carol's guests are Carol Channing and Steve Lawrence in this episode, which features the latest "As The Stomach Turns", and a "Carol & Sis" with Roger and Carol finding themselves in a nudist colony.
Carol's good luck charm Jim Nabors guest stars! This episode is highlighted by Harvey's belated Emmy Award acceptance speech, and a Nostalgia Theatre presentation of the WWII-set "Hollywood Canteen."
